qa.q: How will people's shopping habits change in the future?
qa.a: Well that depends on lots of things. If there are more people there might be fewer resources so you might expect to see people buying fewer things. Similarly if governments intervene to tackle the climate crisis then they might inadvertently reduce consumer spending through the laws they enact because they've restricted access to products or different resources that are used to make these things.
